name: Glam AI
h1: Glam AI ARR: ~$72M from Restyling Photos at Consumer Scale.
intro: Glam AI turns casual phone photos into studio-grade edits — retouching, restyling and viral effects — and sells it as a consumer subscription with heavy paid acquisition. Third-party measurement put it at roughly $72M ARR in 2026, with Leonis Capital charting about nineteen months from launch to $50M. The reported numbers are below.

milestones.note: Founded by serial consumer-app entrepreneur Victor Shaburov to apply generative AI to casual photo and video editing.
Viral one-tap effects — restyling, enhancement, themed transformations — spread through TikTok, feeding an ad-driven acquisition engine.
Reaches $50M annualized run rate roughly nineteen months after launch, per Leonis Capital's tracking of fastest AI ramps.
Third-party measurement pegs Glam AI among the top consumer AI apps by revenue signal, at roughly $72M ARR.

modelTitle: One-Tap Effects, Subscription Traps Avoided the Honest Way: Volume.
modelParagraphs: Glam AI's product surface is deliberately shallow: pick a photo, tap an effect, get a studio-looking result. The depth is in the funnel economics — hundreds of ad variants on TikTok and Meta matched to viral effects, each paying back on the first subscription period. Consumer AI editing is a margin war fought in ad dashboards, and Glam operationalized it.

Revenue is app-store subscriptions with trial-to-paid conversion, plus one-off credit purchases for premium renders. Effects double as ad creative — the output is the marketing — which keeps content costs near zero while the effect library refreshes acquisition continuously.
revenueMix: Auto-renewing weekly/monthly plans with trial funnels on the app stores.
One-off payments for premium effects and renders.
Paid UA against viral effects whose output is the ad creative itself.

faqs.q: What Is Glam AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Roughly $72 million, per third-party revenue measurement cited in 2026. Glam AI has not disclosed exact figures; Leonis Capital independently charts it at about nineteen months from launch to $50M. Treat both as measured estimates.
Consumer apps for AI photo and video editing — retouching, restyling and themed viral effects applied to casual phone photos in one tap, sold via app-store subscriptions.

faqs.q: How Does Glam AI Grow So Fast?
faqs.a: A paid-acquisition engine on TikTok and Meta: viral effects generate ad creative organically, hundreds of variants are tested continuously, and subscription payback is engineered into the first billing period.
Victor Shaburov, a serial consumer-app entrepreneur, founded the company in 2023. The playbook is consumer-app funnel discipline applied to generative editing.

faqs.q: How Is This Different from Midjourney-Style Tools?
faqs.a: Midjourney serves creators who prompt; Glam serves mainstream users who tap. The unit of value is a shareable edited photo in seconds, monetized through app-store subscriptions rather than creator plans.
